theorems.name: Submission.dorag_gc_graph_map_volume_le_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k P : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → Continuous f → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ v ∈ A, z + ι v + ι' (f v) ∈ R.measure.support ∩ W) → Measure.map (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) (volume.restrict A) ≤ R.measure.restrict ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' A)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
